name: Yamiyo
source:
Main heroine is a new teacher. A beautiful student girl comes to her for love advice, but gets in a trap leading to obscene world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是一名刚刚赴任的教师。一名漂亮的女学生前来向她请教恋爱烦恼，却因此落入一场通往淫靡世界的陷阱。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
